task.description: Rework 1: fix the N=40 flat-tail rationale defect that could silently drop the discovery header.

result.note: Ran mix test --only wasm_hang --dry-run live twice, confirmed CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR's numbers (header at line 32, terminator at line 264, ~232-line span, ~285-287 total lines, consistently reproducible, dominated by interleaved ExUnit compiler-deprecation warnings for unrelated files, matching the module's own DEVIATION comment). Replaced the flat 40-line tail with an explicit header search (find_discovery_window/2) mirroring extract_test_list_block/1's own literal-line header match so the message's notion of the header never diverges from the real parsing logic. Header found: capture a window from the header line up to a new bound @wasm_hang_discovery_window_lines = 300 (margin above the observed 232-line span), stopping early at the terminator if reached; if the bound is exhausted first, the message says so explicitly rather than implying completeness. Header not found at all: stated explicitly as a more severe distinct signal ('dry-run itself may be broken'), falls back to the retained last_output_lines/2 40-line tail helper since there's no header to anchor to. Retry-output-empty case unchanged. Updated SS3.2/SS3.3, SS4's failure-shape table, SS5's test list (added a2/a3/a4 for noisy-but-bounded, bound-exceeded, and header-absent cases, two new fixtures), SS6's open questions grounded honestly (300-line bound can still be insufficient under future growth, but now flags insufficiency via terminator_reached? = false instead of silently failing). Did not touch retry decision/logic, scope exclusions, or the ISS-0524.yaml append. Self-check: grep for defmodule|def |defp |schema "|Enum.|fn ->|case do|cond do|with do|pipe operator returned zero matches.
